# MinION 
Data from a previous MinION run on a culture dominated by a bacterium in the genus Vibrio. The dominant organism has two large chromosomes with sizes around 3.4Mb and 1.8Mb respectively. We also expect some smaller plasmids. At very high coverage it was also revealed that this data contained another bacterium (a Gammaproteobacterium) which was around 100 times less abundant than the Vibrio.

# Redbean assembly
- one of the fastest long read genome assemblers

```{bash}
cd redbean
pwd

#first 3 files which equates to 12000 reads and around 6x coverage of the target genome
cat /pvol/data/amtp4/*_[012]f.fastq > amtp4.fastq

#run assembly
wtdbg2 -x ont -g 5m -t 4 -i amtp4.fastq -fo amtp4
wtpoa-cns -t 4 -i amtp4.ctg.lay.gz -fo amtp4.ctg.fa

#time taken = real 44.070 sec, user 185.530 sec, sys 8.140 sec

```

# Activity 1 
Inspect assembly statistics USING REDBEAN
```{bash}
assembly-stats amtp4.ctg.fa

#output
stats for amtp4.ctg.fa
sum = 3816931, n = 129, ave = 29588.61, largest = 159610
N50 = 48075, n = 23 # 
N60 = 33615, n = 33
N70 = 28879, n = 45
N80 = 21464, n = 60
N90 = 13023, n = 83
N100 = 2697, n = 129 #
N_count = 0
Gaps = 0

```
contiguity: n = contig size at which half of all assembles bases reside in contigs of this size or longer (Longest contig = 0) 
smallest quantitiy at top half of assembly 

completeness (closer to 1 = more ), proportion of estimated genome: assembled genome size/ estimated genome size 
Core genes 

correctness: 


## Run Redbean with higher coverage
REDO assembly with better coverage depth ()
Data equivalent to ~20x coverage
```{bash}
#run assembly
cat /pvol/data/amtp4/*.fastq > amtp4_20x.fastq
wtdbg2 -x ont -g 5m -t 4 -i amtp4_20x.fastq -fo amtp4_20x
wtpoa-cns -t 4 -i amtp4_20x.ctg.lay.gz -fo amtp4_20x.ctg.fa

#time taken:real 164.938 sec, user 603.150 sec, sys 32.890 sec
```

```{bash}
assembly-stats amtp4_20x.ctg.fa
#output
stats for amtp4_20x.ctg.fa
sum = 7575981, n = 97, ave = 78102.90, largest = 3342848
N50 = 1764934, n = 2 
N60 = 1764934, n = 2
N70 = 98920, n = 4
N80 = 44062, n = 17
N90 = 26149, n = 38
N100 = 4522, n = 97
N_count = 0
Gaps = 0
```
N50 - 2 contigs required to complete 50% of the whole sequence, usually the largest size genome sequence/ number of base pairs

# Flye assembly

## Move to Flye folder
```{bash}
pwd
cd ../flye_genome
pwd
```

## Run Flye on both datasets 
```{bash}
#Make symbolic links to same raw data from redbean
ln -s ../redbean/amtp4.fastq .
ln -s ../redbean/amtp4_20x.fastq .

```


# Bandage 
Depth - average number of reads that cover a given region of the genome sequence e.g., 50x or 100x coverage
- to assemble a gene : needs overlaps, long reads,account for errors
e.g., 
read 1:     xxxx
read 2:     xxxxxx
read 3: xxxxxx
contig: xxxxxxxxxx
depth = 3, contig = 1

repeat: central or around circle, other contigs "pass through"
